A POCKET GUIDE TO THE WILDERNESS

Make yourself at home.

01

Start with a tree.

Hold the left mouse button on a nearby trunk to collect wood. Press E for your 2 × 2 crafting grid. Click a recipe to fill the grid, then take its output. Make planks, sticks, and a crafting table.

02

Dig a little deeper.

Place a crafting table to unlock the 3 × 3 grid. Wooden picks mine stone; stone picks mine iron; iron picks mine diamond. Tools wear out. Place a furnace, use it with F, and smelt ore with coal.

03

Give the night a doorstop.

Build walls and a door before dark. Craft a red bed using wool from sheep; sleep to skip the night and set your spawn. Store supplies in a chest. Till dirt with a hoe, plant seeds, harvest wheat, and craft bread. Zombies attack after dark; use a sword. Eat with Q.

On touch screens, use the movement buttons, switch between Mine and Build/use, then hold a spot in the world. Right-click or Build/use opens doors, tables, furnaces, chests, and beds. The world keeps moving while you craft; Escape pauses it. Saves stay in this browser. Export a world from the pause menu to keep a backup.
